children: Because the membership inherits, deploy already carries the owner’s authority for owner-only DDL. The migration recipe still uses
before creating objects—not to pass the ownership check, but so that everything the migration

children: Add the durable owner and make schema ownership explicit:

content.name: Fence
children:
roles:
  - name: deploy
    login: true
  - name: app_owner
  - name: orders_reader

schemas:
  - name: app
    owner: app_owner

memberships:
  - role: app_owner
    members:
      - name: deploy
